Hi Joe / Aisha —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our discovery call, I put together a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (attached) to align on milestones, owners, and a target close date. High-level items in the MAP:

- Milestone 1 (Discovery complete): NovaHealth owners: Joe / Aisha; Redwood owner: Marissa — target: 2026-10-15
- Milestone 2 (Security & Compliance review): NovaHealth: Security team; Redwood: Rishi — target: 2026-11-01
- Milestone 3 (Pilot/POC): NovaHealth: Clinical Ops; Redwood: Engineering lead (TBD) — target: 2026-12-01
- Milestone 4 (Procurement & Contract): NovaHealth: Procurement; Redwood: Legal/Sales — target close: 2026-11-15

Open dependencies:
- Security questionnaire completion (we'll share our SOC2 summary + answers)
- Pilot dataset access (NDA + sample data)

Please review the MAP and let me know: 1) any missing milestones or owners, 2) whether the target close date looks OK, and 3) who your procurement contact will be so we can loop them in.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Your feedback on MAP v1.0 by Oct 6
2) Rishi to start security thread once contacts confirmed
3) Schedule 30-min pilot scoping session w/ Clinical Ops (target week of Oct 18)

Thanks — I can update the MAP quickly and re-send.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan (MAP) Draft & Next Steps — NovaHealth

Marissa — thanks for the recap and MAP. Helpful framing. A couple of updates from our side after an internal prioritization sync:

1) Timeline re-forecast: we are moving some budget to a Q1 initiative which pushes our internal procurement/contract sign-off to late Jan 2027. Realistically, target close will be ~2027-01-31.
2) Security review: our security team is constrained this quarter; the earliest they can get to the questionnaire and sample data is mid-November. That will push the pilot start by ~6 weeks.
3) Procurement contact: for contracting and PO routing please engage procurement@novahealth.com (I will copy them when we kick off).

I still want to proceed — this is a priority for our Ops team — but we need MAP dates updated to reflect the reprioritization. Could you send a v1.1 with the updated milestones/targets and a revised pilot window?

Thanks,
Joe
Director, Clinical Innovation
NovaHealth
joe.smith@novahealth.com

Joe / Aisha —

Thanks for the update and the transparency on the timeline shift — totally understandable. I've updated the MAP to reflect a Jan 31, 2027 target close and pushed the pilot/start dates accordingly (attached v1.1). Summary of key changes in v1.1:

- Target close: 2027-01-31 (was 2026-11-15)
- Security & Compliance review: moved to Nov 15 - Dec 15 window; Redwood (Rishi) to provide SOC2 summary and questionnaire responses by Nov 10
- Pilot scoping: tentative start Feb 1, 2027; pilot duration ~6 weeks
- Procurement: include procurement@novahealth.com; Redwood legal to share draft SOW for review (attached)

Action items for NovaHealth:
- Confirm procurement contact (noted you shared procurement@novahealth.com)
- Confirm an internal security point-of-contact for the questionnaire so Rishi can start the thread
- Approve MAP v1.1 or provide edits by Oct 20 so we can lock milestones and update resourcing

If helpful, I can set a 30-min working session next week with Rishi + your security lead to walk through the questionnaire. Proposed windows: Oct 12-14 (US morning). Let me know which day/time works.

Best,
Marissa
